utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. Mr. Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-04-75-T, the Prosecutor versus Goran Hadzic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. May we have the appearances, please, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President and Your Honours. For the Prosecution Douglas Stringer; Matthew Olmsted; intern, Angelika Bamberger; and Case Manager, Thomas Laugel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For the Defence of Goran Hadzic, Zoran Zivanovic, lead counsel, and Christopher Gosnell, co-counsel. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. First of all, about the documents, the documents the parties agreed upon yesterday. So they are admitted as for 4331, 4334, 4338.1, and 6237 -- I'm sorry. Thank you. They're not admitted. They're admitted -- added to the 65 ter list, the exhibit list, of course. So you got the numbers, and one is substituted, 6237 is substituted. Okay. That's for one.

utterances.speaker: MR. OLMSTED
utterances.text: Your Honours, a quick correction. The numbers are, I believe, 6331, 6334, 6338.1. You said 4.

utterances.speaker: MR. OLMSTED
utterances.text: We'll sort it out in the end, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: No, but you're right. It's 6, indeed. Thank you. The witness for today is in closed session, so we go into closed session now, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're back in open session, Your Honours. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Registrar. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 2nd day of November, 2012, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 2.02 p.m.,
